## AeroAPI plans compared

| Plan | Cost structure | What it includes and who it suits |
|---|---|---|
| **Personal** | No monthly minimum. Up to **$5/month** in query usage is free, or **$10/month for ADS-B feeders**; usage fees apply beyond that allowance. | For personal or academic use. Includes current flight status and tracks, plus static maps and imagery. Does not include historical flight data, alerts, or business-use rights. Limit: **10 result sets/minute**. |
| **Standard** | Per-query fees with a **$100/month minimum**. | For business internal use and business-to-consumer (B2C) use; does not allow business-to-business (B2B) commercialization. Adds historical data, flight alerts, and email support. Includes static maps and imagery. Limits: **5 result sets/second** and **500,000 history result sets/month**. |
| **Premium** | Per-query fees with a **$1,000/month minimum**. | Allows business internal, B2C, and B2B use. Adds Foresight predictions and Aireon space-based ADS-B, plus phone support, invoicing, and a **99.5% uptime guarantee**. Includes static maps and imagery. Limits: **100 result sets/second** and **500,000 history result sets/month**. |

**How usage pricing works:** Fees are charged per result set, and one result set equals **15 records**; a single query can return multiple result sets. For example, flight search is **$0.050/result set** and retrieving flight information is **$0.005/result set**. Prices may change.

**Volume discounts:** Standard and Premium accounts are eligible. The first **$1,000/month** is billed at list price; the listed discount rises with monthly usage: **30%** from $1,000–$2,000, **51%** from $2,000–$4,000, **65%** from $4,000–$8,000, **76%** from $8,000–$16,000, **83%** from $16,000–$32,000, **88%** from $32,000–$64,000, and **94%** above $64,000. The page notes that additional discounts may be available for 3- or 4-year commitments.

**Bottom line:** Personal is the no-minimum tier for personal or academic projects; Standard covers business internal and B2C use; Premium is the tier for B2B commercialization and advanced data, support, and throughput needs.

arguments.final_answer:
FlightAware AeroAPI has three plans — **Personal, Standard and Premium** — and none of them has a flat monthly subscription price. The cards only say "Get started"; what you actually pay is per query, with a monthly minimum on the two paid tiers. Here is the side-by-side from the comparison table on flightaware.com/commercial/aeroapi:

| | Personal | Standard | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Charging basis | Per-query usage fees, up to **$5 free per month** ($10/month for ADS-B feeders) | Per-query usage fees subject to a monthly minimum | Per-query usage fees subject to a monthly minimum |
| Monthly minimum | **None** | **$100/month** | **$1,000/month** |
| Result-set rate limit | 10 result sets/minute | 5 result sets/second | 100 result sets/second |
| Historical results | Not included | 500,000 result sets/month | 500,000 result sets/month |
| Volume discounting | Not included | Included | Included |
| Uptime guarantee | — | — | 99.5% |
| Support | — | Email | Email + phone |
| Invoicing | — | — | Yes |
| Allowed use | Personal or academic; storage/distribution of derivative works for those purposes only | Business & B2C use: historical data, flight alerting, email support | Business, B2C commercial and full B2B commercial use |

**Included data sets:** static maps and imagery are in all three tiers; Alerts are Standard and up; Historical Flight Data, FlightAware Foresight and Aireon space-based ADS-B are Premium only (Foresight and Aireon need to be enabled by contacting FlightAware, with use restrictions).

**What a query costs** (result set = 15 records; the per-query fee table is shared by all tiers, only the monthly minimum differs): flight search, search/positions and search/advanced are $0.050 per result set, flight search/count $0.020, flight info by ident $0.005, canonical ident $0.001. There are further rows for Foresight, airports, operators, alerts, history and miscellaneous that I only captured partially, so treat the list above as the headline examples rather than the full fee schedule.

**Volume discount ladder** (Standard and Premium): $0–1,000/month no discount; $1–2k 30%; $2–4k 51%; $4–8k 65%; $8–16k 76%; $16–32k 83%; $32–64k 88%; above $64k 94%.

**Short version:** Personal is free to start with no commitment and a $5/month usage credit, but it is limited to personal/academic use at 10 result sets a minute and no historical data. Standard costs at least $100/month and is the first tier you can build a business on (B2C, historical data, volume discounts, email support). Premium at $1,000/month minimum adds the premium feeds (Foresight, Aireon), 100 result sets/second, 99.5% uptime, phone support and invoicing — and it is the only tier allowed to commercialise B2B.

One thing the page does not give: a fixed monthly price for any tier. The minimums above are floors, not subscriptions, so the real monthly bill is your query volume minus the tier's discount, with no charge at all on Personal below the $5 free allowance.

arguments.final_answer:
FlightAware's AeroAPI comes in three tiers — **Personal, Standard and Premium** — and none of them carries a flat subscription price. The plan cards only offer "Get started"; what you pay is per query, and the two paid tiers add a monthly minimum. Side by side, from the comparison table on the AeroAPI page:

| | Personal | Standard | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| How you're charged | Per-query usage fees, up to **$5 free per month** ($10/month if you feed ADS-B) | Per-query usage fees, subject to a monthly minimum | Per-query usage fees, subject to a monthly minimum |
| Monthly minimum | None | **$100/month** | **$1,000/month** |
| Result-set rate limit | 10 result sets/minute | 5 result sets/second | 100 result sets/second |
| Historical result sets | Not included | 500,000/month | 500,000/month |
| Volume discounting | Not included | Included | Included |
| Uptime guarantee | — | — | 99.5% |
| Support | — | Email | Email + phone |
| Invoicing | — | — | Yes |
| Permitted use | Storage and distribution of derivative works for personal or academic purposes only | Business and business-to-consumer purposes | Business, B2C commercial, and all B2B commercial purposes |

Included on top of the base: static maps and imagery in all three tiers; Flight Alerts and Historical Flight Data from Standard up; FlightAware Foresight and Aireon space-based ADS-B only on Premium (both marked with an asterisk — you contact FlightAware to have them enabled, and use restrictions apply). Internal use for personal purposes and academic use are allowed on every tier; internal business use and B2C commercialization start at Standard; B2B commercialization is Premium only.

**What a query costs.** Fees are billed per result set, and one result set equals 15 records; prices may change. The fee schedule is the same across tiers — the tier only sets the monthly minimum and the discount. The parts I could read in full:

- Flights: `/flights/search` $0.050, `/flights/search/positions` $0.050, `/flights/search/count` $0.020, `/flights/search/advanced` $0.050, `/flights/{ident}` $0.005, `/flights/{ident}/canonical` $0.001, `POST /flights/{ident}/intents` $0.000, `/flights/{id}/position` $0.010, `/flights/{id}/track` $0.012, `/flights/{id}/route` $0.010, `/flights/{id}/map` $0.030 — all per result set.
- Foresight: `/foresight/flights/{ident}` $0.015, `/foresight/flights/search/advanced` $0.060, `/foresight/flights/{id}/position` $0.020.
- Airports: `/airports` $0.005, `/airports/nearby` $0.004, `/airports/delays` $0.050, `/airports/{id}` $0.015, `/airports/{id}/canonical` $0.001, `/airports/{id}/nearby` $0.004, `/airports/{id}/delays` $0.010, `/airports/{id}/flights` $0.020, `/airports/{id}/flights/arrivals` $0.005, `/airports/{id}/flights/arrivals/cancellations` $0.020, `/airports/{id}/flights/departures` $0.005, `/airports/{id}/flights/departures/cancellations` $0.020, `/airports/{id}/flights/scheduled_departures` $0.005, `/airports/{id}/flights/scheduled_arrivals` $0.005, `/airports/{id}/flights/to/{dest_id}` $0.050, `/airports/{id}/flights/counts` $0.100, `/airports/{id}/weather/observations` $0.002, `/airports/{id}/weather/forecast` $0.002, `/airports/{id}/routes/{dest_id}` $0.020.

The fee page also has tabs for Operators, Alerts, History, Miscellaneous and Account. I did not get their rows, so I can't quote prices for those endpoints — the list above is the flights/foresight/airports portion, not the whole schedule.

**Volume discount ladder** (Standard and Premium only): the first $1,000 of monthly usage bills at list price, then $1,000–2,000 gets 30% off, $2,000–4,000 51%, $4,000–8,000 65%, $8,000–16,000 76%, $16,000–32,000 83%, $32,000–64,000 88%, and anything above $64,000 94% off. Standard at $100/month minimum is the first tier you can run a business on: historical data, alerting, 5 result sets a second, volume discounts, email support. Premium at $1,000/month minimum adds Foresight and Aireon ADS-B, 100 result sets a second, 500,000 historical result sets a month, a 99.5% uptime guarantee, phone support, invoicing, and B2B commercialization rights.

FlightAware lists three AeroAPI plans: **Personal, Standard, and Premium**. Their comparison is:

| Feature | Personal | Standard | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly minimum | None | $100/month | $1,000/month |
| Query pricing | Per-query fees; the pricing table notes up to $5 free per month, or $10 for ADS-B feeders | Per-query fees; $100/month minimum | Per-query fees; $1,000/month minimum |
| Result-set rate limit | 10/minute | 5/second | 100/second |
| Historical results allowance | Not included | 500,000 result sets/month | 500,000 result sets/month |
| Alerts and historical flight data | Alerts and historical data not included | Included | Included |
| Foresight and Aireon space-based ADS-B | Not included | Not included | Included; contact FlightAware to enable, and restrictions apply |
| Permitted use | Personal or academic use | Business internal use and B2C commercialization; not B2B commercialization | Business internal use and B2C and B2B commercialization |
| Other listed features | Static maps and imagery | Static maps and imagery, volume discounts, email support, invoicing | Static maps and imagery, volume discounts, email and phone support, invoicing, and a 99.5% uptime guarantee |

The table also lists **email support** for Standard and Premium, **phone support** only for Premium, and no uptime guarantee for Personal or Standard. Static maps and imagery are included in all three plans.

Per-query fees vary by endpoint. Examples include **$0.050/result set** for flight searches, **$0.005** for `GET /flights/{ident}`, **$0.010** for a current-position lookup, and **$0.030** for a flight map.

**Bottom line:** Personal has no monthly minimum and is limited to personal or academic use. Standard adds business and historical-data features for a $100 monthly minimum. Premium raises the rate limit, allows B2B commercialization, and adds the listed premium support and service benefits, with a $1,000 monthly minimum.
arguments.verification: Compare available AeroAPI plans — FlightAware’s AeroAPI comparison lists Personal, Standard, and Premium and provides their monthly minimums, usage pricing notes, rate and historical-result limits, included features, use permissions, support, service benefits, and example endpoint fees.

arguments.final_answer:
FlightAware lists three AeroAPI plans: **Personal, Standard, and Premium**. The comparison below is from the AeroAPI plan table on FlightAware.

| | Personal | Standard | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly minimum | None | $100/month | $1,000/month |
| Per-query charges | Usage fees; up to $5/month free (or $10/month for ADS-B feeders) | Per-query fees, subject to the monthly minimum | Per-query fees, subject to the monthly minimum |
| Result-set rate limit | 10/minute | 5/second | 100/second |
| Historical results | Not included | 500,000 result sets/month | 500,000 result sets/month |
| Alerts and historical flight data | Not included | Included | Included |
| Foresight and Aireon space-based ADS-B | Not included | Not included | Included; contact FlightAware to enable, and restrictions apply |
| Business use | Personal or academic use; no business internal use or commercialization | Business internal use and B2C commercialization; no B2B commercialization | Business internal use and B2C and B2B commercialization |
| Other listed benefits | Static maps and imagery | Static maps and imagery, volume discounting, email support | Static maps and imagery, volume discounting, email and phone support, invoicing, and a 99.5% uptime guarantee |

Per-query rates depend on the API endpoint. Examples on the pricing table include **$0.050/result set** for flight searches, **$0.005** for `GET /flights/{ident}`, **$0.010** for current-position lookup, and **$0.030** for a flight map. These are examples, not a complete rate card.

**In short:** Personal is for personal/academic use with a low rate limit and no monthly minimum; Standard adds business and historical-data use with a $100 minimum; Premium has the highest throughput, broader commercial rights (including B2B), and the expanded support and service benefits, with a $1,000 minimum.

arguments.final_answer:
FlightAware's AeroAPI comes in **three tiers — Personal, Standard, Premium** — and it's priced **per query** (per "result set"), not as a flat subscription. The tiers differ mainly in what you're licensed to do with the data, the monthly minimum, the rate limit and the support level; the per-call price list is the same for everyone.

## The three plans

| | **Personal** | **Standard** | **Premium** |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Purpose** | Personal or academic use only | Business and B2C use | Business, B2C **and all B2B** commercial use |
| **Included APIs** | Current flight status and tracks; static maps and imagery | Everything in Personal **plus** flight alerting and historical flight data | Everything in Standard **plus** Foresight predictions and Aireon space-based ADS-B* |
| **Monthly minimum** | **None** — usage fees only, with up to **$5 free per month** ($10 free for ADS-B feeders) | **$100/month** (subject to minimum) | **$1,000/month** (subject to minimum) |
| **Result-set rate limit** | 10 result sets/minute | 5 result sets/second | 100 result sets/second |
| **Historical result sets** | Not included | 500,000/month | 500,000/month |
| **Volume discounting** | No | Yes | Yes |
| **Licensed use** | Storage/distribution of derivative works for personal or academic purposes | Also internal business use and B2C commercialisation | Also B2B commercialisation |
| **Support** | — | Email support | Email **and phone** support; invoicing available; 99.5% uptime guarantee |

\* Foresight and Aireon require contacting FlightAware to enable, and some use restrictions apply. Alerts are excluded from Personal. Every plan includes internal personal use and academic use.

Each card has a "Get started" button. The page frames the choice as "choose the appropriate tier based on your use case and data needs, taking note of limitations on usage and storage restrictions."

## How the charges work

Pricing is per **result set**, defined as **15 records**; one API page equals one result set, and the `max_pages` parameter controls how many sets a call returns. Each of the eight fee tabs:

- **Flights** — $0.000–$0.050 per set: search $0.050, search/positions $0.050, search/advanced $0.050, search/count $0.020, flight by ident $0.005, canonical ident $0.001, flight intent POST $0.000, position $0.010, track $0.012, route $0.010, map image $0.030.
- **Foresight** — flight by ident $0.015, advanced search $0.060, position $0.020.
- **Airports** — $0.001–$0.100: airport list $0.005, nearby $0.004, all delays $0.050, airport detail $0.015, canonical code $0.001, nearby airports $0.004, airport delays $0.010, airport flights $0.020, arrivals/departures/scheduled arrival/scheduled departure $0.005 each, flights between two airports $0.050, flight counts $0.100, weather observation $0.002, forecast $0.002, routes $0.020.
- **Operators** — $0.001–$0.100: operator list $0.002, detail $0.015, canonical code $0.001, operator flights $0.030, scheduled/arrivals/enroute $0.005 each, cancellations $0.020, flight counts $0.100.
- **Alerts** — alert delivery callback $0.020 per set; creating, reading, editing and deleting alerts and the callback endpoint are all $0.000.
- **History** — $0.020–$0.200: historical flight $0.020, track $0.060, track map image $0.140, route $0.040, airport arrivals $0.020, arrival cancellations $0.040, departures $0.020, departure cancellations $0.040, airport-to-airport $0.120, aircraft last flight $0.200, operator flights $0.020, operator cancellations $0.040.
- **Miscellaneous** — blocked check $0.020, aircraft owner $0.002, aircraft type $0.100, schedules $0.020, disruption counts $0.020 (global and per entity).
- **Account** — usage statistics $0.000.

**Volume discounting** applies to Standard and Premium only: the first $1,000/month at list price, then 30% off ($1,000–2,000), 51% ($2,000–4,000), 65% ($4,000–8,000), 76% ($8,000–16,000), 83% ($16,000–32,000), 88% ($32,000–64,000) and 94% above $64,000 per month. Further discounts are available on 3- or 4-year term commitments, by contacting FlightAware. FlightAware notes prices may change.

**In short:** a hobby or research project can run on Personal with no commitment and a few dollars a month; a business needs Standard's $100/month floor for commercial B2C use and historical data; anything sold B2B, or needing Foresight predictions, Aireon satellite ADS-B, a 99.5% uptime guarantee, phone support or invoicing, requires Premium's $1,000/month minimum.
